information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org).
